description: This Java class `PatientIdentifierValidator` provides validation logic for `PatientIdentifier` objects in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes methods for supporting validation, checking unique identifiers, validating format, and integrating with external validators.

classes.name: PatientIdentifierValidator
classes.description: A validator class for `PatientIdentifier` objects in the OpenMRS system, implementing Spring's `Validator` interface and providing static methods for detailed validation logic.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the given class can be supported by this validator; returns true if the class is assignable from `PatientIdentifier`.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on a `PatientIdentifier` object, including custom validation and field length checks.

methods.name: validateIdentifier
methods.description: Validates a `PatientIdentifier` object, ensuring it is not null, not voided, unique if required, and has a valid identifier.

methods.name: validateIdentifier
methods.description: Validates the identifier string against its type, including format and optional validator checks.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat
methods.description: Checks whether an identifier matches a specified regex format, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstValidator
methods.description: Uses an external `IdentifierValidator` to validate an identifier and throws exceptions if invalid.
